summary: Native <select> with the system’s field styling and anatomy. Uses the operating system picker, ideal on mobile and in SSR forms without JavaScript.
whenToUse: Short, simple lists, especially on mobile.
Forms that must work before hydration.
whenNotToUse: Rich options, search or multiple selection: use Select, Combobox or MultiSelect.
inherits: Native <select> attributes (name, autoComplete, form…), except multiple.
accessibility: Fully native semantics and keyboard support.
Errors linked via aria-describedby and aria-invalid.
responsive: On mobile it opens the operating system picker.
customization: Decorative arrow replaceable via CSS; logical positioning (RTL).
commonMistakes: Using the placeholder as a label.
limits: The style of the open menu depends on the browser/OS.
